description: Establish a green baseline for both the Python backend and the TypeScript frontend so the redaction change can be verified against known-passing tests. pytest is NOT preinstalled in this environment; frontend node_modules may be absent.
steps: From repo root /projects/sandbox/KiroCrew, install backend dev dependencies into the active Python environment using uv: `uv pip install -e '.[dev]'`. If the editable extras path is slow or fails, fall back to `uv pip install pytest pytest-asyncio hypothesis` (the redaction tests only need pytest + stdlib).

Confirm the backend redaction baseline is green: `python3 -m pytest test/test_redaction_mirror_parity.py test/test_diagnostics.py -q`. Also run the exfiltration-relevant portion of test_security.py: `python3 -m pytest test/test_security.py -k 'exfil or Exfil or Slack or presigned or oauth or Oauth or credential or Credential' -q`.
Install frontend dependencies: `cd website && npm ci` (network is OPEN_INTERNET).
Confirm the frontend sanitize baseline is green: `cd website && npx vitest run src/test/sanitizeCredentials.test.ts src/test/sanitizeXss.jsdom.test.ts`.

Confirm the frontend builds (this is the guard for the Safari-14 no-lookbehind constraint): `cd website && npm run build`. If the full build is too slow, at minimum run `cd website && npx tsc -b` to typecheck.
Record the exact commands that worked in the feature findings so later features reuse them.
acceptance_criteria: `python3 -m pytest test/test_redaction_mirror_parity.py test/test_diagnostics.py -q` runs and reports all tests passing (no collection errors).
`cd website && npx vitest run src/test/sanitizeCredentials.test.ts` runs and reports passing.
`cd website && npm run build` completes successfully (or `npx tsc -b` passes if build is deferred), confirming the baseline entry chunk compiles.
The working set of setup/test commands is recorded in findings.
verification: cd website && npx vitest run src/test/sanitizeCredentials.test.ts
findings:
BASELINE GREEN. No application code modified.

CRITICAL ENV NOTE: the default `python3` on PATH is 3.9.25, but pyproject.toml requires-python is >=3.10, so `uv pip install -e '.[dev]'` against the default interpreter fails. pyenv has 3.10.20/3.11.15/3.12.13/3.13.13/3.14.4 available. Fix: create a uv venv on 3.12 and install into it. `.venv`, `.venv-x86`, `.venv311` are already in .gitignore (repo root), and website/node_modules + website/dist are gitignored too, so none pollute git.

EXACT WORKING SETUP (from repo root /projects/sandbox/KiroCrew):
  uv venv --python /root/.pyenv/versions/3.12.13/bin/python3 .venv
  source .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -e '.[dev]'   # ~installs pytest 9.1.1, pytest-asyncio 1.4.0, hypothesis, etc.
  cd website && npm ci   # network OPEN_INTERNET; succeeds (306 pkgs; 3 npm-audit vulns are pre-existing, unrelated)

EXACT WORKING TEST/BUILD COMMANDS (activate the venv first for backend: `source .venv/bin/activate`):
  BACKEND: python3 -m pytest test/test_redaction_mirror_parity.py test/test_diagnostics.py -q    => 52 passed
  BACKEND: python3 -m pytest test/test_security.py -k 'exfil or Exfil or Slack or presigned or oauth or Oauth or credential or Credential' -q    => 262 passed
  FRONTEND: cd website && npx vitest run src/test/sanitizeCredentials.test.ts src/test/sanitizeXss.jsdom.test.ts    => 14 passed (2 files)
  FRONTEND BUILD (Safari-14 no-lookbehind guard): cd website && npm run build    => 'built in ~24s', succeeds

Notes for later features: the backend venv must be re-activated in each new shell (`source /projects/sandbox/KiroCrew/.venv/bin/activate`). Deprecation warnings from xdist/asyncio in pytest output are pre-existing and harmless. `npm run build` is slow-ish (~25s) but works; `npx tsc -b` is the faster typecheck-only fallback.
